snippet.title: Prison Boss Prohibition - Official Content Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Learn more about the world, chickens, and features of Prison Boss: Prohibition in this trailer for co-op sequel to Prison Boss VR. The trailer also shows what you can expect with the New Yolk Fashion Week celebration, where the game features continuous free cosmetic and content, with July 24th bringing The Mafioso outfit to the game. Prison Boss: Prohibition is available now on Meta Quest and Steam VR.
